technical-summary: engine_identity now memoises its digest per process against a stamp of every runtime file (size, inode, mtime, ctime) taken before hashing, so a reused start hashes the roughly 428 MB runtime once (about 1.2 s) instead of 3 to 5 times; changed, added or removed files are hashed again and every comparison and refusal is unchanged. kMaxHostPoolChanges documented as a protocol-level bound. Evidence and tests added.
user-summary-candidate: Starts that reuse a prior measured run no longer re-hash the installed runtime several times.
